answer: The strongest lever is simple: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because forge only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, falcon is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any zenith approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
